issues.description: Plan line 9 states that '과거 마감일 허용은 사용자가 직접 확정하고 승인한 결정이다' (allowing past due dates is a decision directly confirmed and approved by the user). However, neither settledDecisions (Q-1~Q-7, DETAIL-1~DETAIL-3) nor originalRequirements record any user decision regarding past due dates. Attributing an unmade decision to the user violates the audit rule that a planner proposal must not be represented as a user-approved decision.
issues.suggestedDirection: Remove the claim that the user directly decided or approved past due dates. State it instead as a planner design proposal subject to user approval of the plan, or seek the user's explicit confirmation if past due dates should be permitted.

마감일시는 시간대 없는 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm으로 저장하고 입력한 달력 날짜와 시·분을 그대로 표시한다. 연도0001~9999의 윤년 포함 실제 날짜, 시00~23, 분00~59만 허용한다. UTC 변환·현재시간 비교·알림·기한순 정렬은 없다.

decision.feedback: issue-c55ca3bdebfe029f: Plan line 9 states that '과거 마감일 허용은 사용자가 직접 확정하고 승인한 결정이다' (allowing past due dates is a decision directly confirmed and approved by the user). However, neither settledDecisions (Q-1~Q-7, DETAIL-1~DETAIL-3) nor originalRequirements record any user decision regarding past due dates. Attributing an unmade decision to the user violates the audit rule that a planner proposal must not be represented as a user-approved decision. — Remove the claim that the user directly decided or approved past due dates. State it instead as a planner design proposal subject to user approval of the plan, or seek the user's explicit confirmation if past due dates should be permitted.
